content.short: PBG is an onchain Cardano protocol providing non-custodial access to diversified, transparent tokenized portfolios.
content.description: PBG is an onchain Cardano protocol focused on tokenized portfolio exposure with transparent holdings, auditable flows, and non-custodial access. The project presents itself as a digital vehicle for diversified asset management where users can monitor positions, fees, and portfolio behavior directly onchain. Its emphasis is on combining diversification, transparency, and revenue-sharing mechanics in a structure that feels closer to tokenized fund infrastructure than a simple trading app.
